designDecisionsAndRationale: Legacy prepare_routes keeps held0003 semantics through PreparationLedger::Legacy so existing fixtures stay byte-identical; the issued path alone takes metered nested preparation, copy_inventory and new precharges.
Authority is granted only by seal/token membership and Rc::ptr_eq, never by scalar or address comparison, so copied DTOs cannot acquire authority.
Pre-Reserve retention executes every :vary/:same placement under the original ledger and additive seeding keeps those executions, so static songs never need runtime first execution (D8, SM2).
All contributors are authenticated before coalescing, and equal-handle events coalesce only with equal descriptors and equal routes, replacing the handle-only dedup (D9-D12).
Pool projections and commands are staged and committed only after the whole realization window succeeds, preserving pools, pending queue and cursor on any failure.
Structural clock barriers are removed only where evidence proves real clock behaviour; uninstrumented paths stay Unknown.
Waves are ordered by dependency with disjoint same-wave paths so wave 1 holds an exact 947-input cohort.
intentionalTradeoffs: Playback coalescing requires equal descriptors where the design says consistent; this is stricter, and tests/song_end_to_end.rs must pass unchanged as the regression witness.
Waves 1 and 2 may leave dead_code clippy diagnostics limited to the declared disposition lists; strict clippy is required only from wave 3.
The wave-4 SONG-16 batch manifest omits tests/song_end_to_end.rs (listed in the design wave table) because wave 4 edits no Rust or test files; the long-run SONG-16 manifest stays unchanged.
Plan-declared gate logs live under tmp/song-mode-riela/session249-* for continuity with held0003 receipts; tmp/song-s249 holds dispatcher attempt evidence.
supportedEdgeCases: Songs with no Slice sites get an empty request list and still issue a view; RequiresUniformBound readiness is not a refusal.
Discarded augmented origins carrying Slice timing must authenticate.
Two distinct invocations with an equal handle both authenticate; conflicting routes fail with no partial result.
Partitioned queries: the union of routes equals the single-query route; half-open step boundaries.
Euclid over an empty subject completes with no events and no false observation; nested Fast, Rev and weighted steps keep orientation.
Envelopes outside [cursor, end) or at/after duration are resolved but not encoded.
Exact and one-less work at issuance, trusted copy, preparation, shared-work transactions, Euclid-over-Slice queries and realization windows; depth max_depth - 1 accepted, max_depth refused.
Foreign, cloned-and-mutated or swapped site/policy references and mismatched tempo/tail/seed settings are refused before any copy; foreign or missing authority refuses before Reserve.
